stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the persistent schema for bearer tokens including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, parent_token_id (for rotation lineage), and scope. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB patterns used in GPTReader and Brain auth.

stories.title: Token Expiration and Rotation Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to enforce token expiration and support secure rotation. Rotation must generate a new token, link to parent token, and optionally invalidate prior tokens based on policy. Expired tokens must be rejected during validation checks.
